claims.head: The Flames’ edge in shot volume
claims.body: The Flames are around the middle of the league for shot volume, and the Canucks are one of the worst. It’s the widest gap between these two, though not a huge one.

VAN.head: The Canucks have a slight edge
VAN.body: The two have been about even at out-chancing opponents lately. Vancouver has home-ice advantage. Still, it’s close: the Flames can make it interesting if they keep the shots coming.

items.text: The Flames have been without Jonathan Huberdeau all season.
The Canucks are newly without Jake DeBrusk, and have had to make do without Thatcher Demko all season. Kevin Lankinen is expected to start.
Morgan Frost has scored in three straight games against Vancouver.
Elias Pettersson (#40) is one assist from passing Alexander Edler for eighth on the Canucks’ all-time assists list.
